title: Compliance lifecycle sprint schedule and risk log — SSO, SOC2, ISO readiness
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: produce a coordinated, sprint-level schedule and living risk log that tracks deliverables required for SOC2 Type II readiness, ISO27001 gap closure, and SSO (SAML/OIDC) enterprise onboarding. This ticket consolidates scope across Console, Dedicated, and Private deployments so engineering, security, and PM have a single source of truth for milestones, owners, and mitigations.

Scope: enrollment and auditability of authentication flows (SSO/SAML/OIDC), audit log retention and export for Private/VPC installs, policy for key rotation/KMS controls that map to SOC2/ISO controls, evidence collection plan for control owners. Out of scope: vendor contracts/legal negotiation for external auditors (tracked separately).

Deliverables: sprint breakdown for next 10 weeks with owners; living risk register with severity, mitigation, and decision checkpoints; test/evidence checklist per control; roll-forward plan to convert sprint outputs into audit artifacts.

Acceptance criteria: (1) each critical control has an assigned owner and test procedure documented; (2) audit log export and retention validated in dedicated and private test environments; (3) SSO SAML metadata flow tested with two enterprise IdPs and documented failure modes; (4) list of required artifacts for SOC2 auditor is enumerated and linked in attachments.

Stakeholders: Security (primary), Runtime Engineering, Console PM/Design, Private Deployments engineering, Solutions Engineering, QA.

Success metrics: reduction in open high/critical risks by 70% before audit window; 90% of control evidence automated or templated; SSO onboarding time reduced from average 5 days to 48 hours for pilot customers.
